This contradicts the assertion that there was a 'revenue recovery in 2025' - there was actually a revenue decline, not a recovery.

findings.key_quote: Year Ended Dec 27, 2025 CCG Revenue $ 32,228... Year Ended Dec 28, 2024 CCG Revenue $ 33,346
findings.justification: CCG revenue decreased from $33,346M in FY2024 to $32,228M in FY2025, a decline of $1,118M. This contradicts the claim that CCG 'led' a revenue recovery - CCG revenue actually declined year-over-year.

findings.key_quote: Dec 27, 2025 Year Ended CCG Revenue $ 32,228... Dec 28, 2024 Year Ended CCG Revenue $ 33,346
findings.justification: This table confirms CCG revenue declined from $33,346M in 2024 to $32,228M in 2025, contradicting the assertion that CCG led a revenue recovery. The segment experienced a revenue decline, not growth.

findings.key_quote: 2024 vs. 2023 Total Intel Products revenue was $49.5 billion in 2024, up $1.2 billion from 2023. CCG revenue increased $1.0 billion from 2023.
findings.justification: This passage discusses the 2024 vs 2023 comparison period, showing CCG revenue growth in that earlier period. However, the claim is about 2025, so this evidence from a different period does not decide the assertion about 2025.

findings.key_quote: YTD 2025 vs. YTD 2024 Our YTD 2025 revenue was $39.2 billion, up $338 million from YTD 2024... CCG revenue decreased 2% from YTD 2024
findings.justification: This evidence covers YTD 2025 (9 months ended September 27, 2025) rather than the full fiscal year 2025. While it shows overall revenue up slightly and CCG down 2%, the period mismatch (9 months vs 12 months) means it does not decide the full-year claim.

findings.key_quote: YTD 2025 vs. YTD 2024 Total Intel Products revenue was $36.2 billion in YTD 2025, down $134 million from YTD 2024. CCG revenue decreased $542 million from YTD 2024.
findings.justification: This passage covers YTD 2025 (9 months ended September 27, 2025), not the full fiscal year 2025. The period mismatch means this does not decide the full-year assertion, though it shows CCG declining in the 9-month period.

findings.key_quote: YTD 2025 vs. YTD 2024 Our YTD 2025 revenue was $25.5 billion, roughly flat with YTD 2024. Intel Products revenue decreased 2% from YTD 2024 primarily due to lower CCG revenue
findings.justification: This evidence covers YTD 2025 (6 months ended June 28, 2025), not the full fiscal year 2025. The period mismatch (6 months vs 12 months) means it does not decide the full-year claim.

findings.key_quote: We derived most of our consolidated revenue in 2025, 2024 and 2023 from our CCG and DCAI product offerings.
findings.justification: This passage states that CCG and DCAI together were the largest revenue sources in 2025, but does not provide specific figures or comparisons to determine whether there was a revenue recovery or which segment led any such recovery.
